text: Code reviews are an essential practice in modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. This process also encourages knowledge sharing, as team members learn from different coding styles and solutions. In addition, regular code reviews help maintain a high level of team quality, because everyone feels responsible for the final product. Although reviews may take extra time, they are a valuable investment. Teams that review code together usually produce cleaner, safer software and grow stronger through shared understanding.
